preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 200000 for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit()) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200000) and T (1 ≤ T ≤ 2·10^9). The second line contains n integers t_i (1 ≤ t_i ≤ 10^9) representing the time when each bowl is ready.
The input consists of exactly n + 2 integers: n, T, and the n t_i values.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max(sum(1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if arrival_time[i] <= t[i] and arrival_time[i] <= T) for arrival_time in possible_arrival_times(n, T, t))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of bowls the dog can eat within T seconds, where arrival_time[i] is the time the dog reaches bowl i (i.e., arrival_time[i] = i), and t is the list of t_i values.
The output is a non-negative integer representing the count of bowls eaten.
